description: Both canonical normal forms on zero inputs are equivalent to \(\top\) or \(\bot\), according to the value of the sole empty row.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.zero_input_normal_forms.{u} {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α] (p : Fin 0 → α)
  (f : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.TruthFunction 0) :
  have K :=
    if (f fun i => i.elim0) = true then Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.verum
    else Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.PropFormula.falsum;
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.SemEquivalent
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.dnfFormula
        (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.canonicalDnf p f))
      K ∧
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.SemEquivalent
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.cnfFormula
        (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.canonicalCnf p f))
      K
